A newly created Fighter starts with: **Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing, and Torches** (item IDs 2, 15, 17, 23).

Defined in `worker/src/services/character.ts:65`, in the `CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` map (entry for `'fighter'`), used by `createCharacter()` (`worker/src/services/character.ts:14`, gear assigned around line 59/65). Item names resolve from the `items` table rows in `worker/src/db/seed.sql` (matched by insertion-order ID). Note: per the docs, item ID 23 ("Torches") is mislabeled "Rations" in code comments (bug B-09).
